newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU electricity production rises 3.2 pct in 1996. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EU electricity production rises 3.2 pct in 1996. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]

text.p: European Union electricity production rose to 2275 terrawatt hours (Corrects from 70.8 terrawatt hours) last year, 3.2 percent up on a year previously, the EU statistics office said in a statement on Wednesday.

Thermal power generation took a 51.1 percent share of production, unchanged from 1995, nuclear generation held 35.4 percent of production, up 0.6 percentage points, and hydroelectric took 13.5 percent, down 0.6 percentage points.
Among the countries posting a rise in production were Denmark, up 45.7 percent, Finland, 9.6 percent, Spain, 6.1 percent and Ireland, six percent.
Eurostat said production falls in Austria, 5.8 percent down, and Sweden, minus 4.6 percent, resulted from low water supplies.
